name: incognito-web
description: Incognito Web — browser interface for qualitative text anonymization (Basic, Advanced, Generative) with person-graph review, companion to the Incognito desktop app.

scripts.gliner2-pii-server: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv-gliner2/bin/python ]; then exec .venv-gliner2/bin/python gliner2_pii_server/server.py; else exec python3 gliner2_pii_server/server.py; fi'
